reviews.author: HomeScreenFrustration
reviews.title: New home screen redesign is terrible
reviews.content: The 2024 home screen redesign removed the ability to quickly access my playlists. Now I have to scroll past 10 sections of AI-generated content just to find what I actually want. Bring back the old layout.

reviews.author: QueueManagement
reviews.title: Queue management is a nightmare
reviews.content: I can't easily rearrange songs in my queue on mobile. I add songs throughout the day and by the time I want to reorder them, the interface is so clunky I give up.

reviews.author: PriceHikeAngry
reviews.title: Premium went up $3 and features got worse
reviews.content: Spotify raised their Premium price by $3 last year and simultaneously made the app worse. Less customization, more algorithmic control, removed features. We're paying more for less.

reviews.author: OfflineCommuter
reviews.title: Offline playlists randomly stop working on commute
reviews.content: I take the subway daily and rely on offline playlists. At least twice a week, Spotify tells me it can't play offline content because I haven't connected to the internet recently. I'm underground. That's the whole point of offline.

reviews.author: TasteProfileReset
reviews.title: Need ability to reset or edit taste profile
reviews.content: I let my little sibling use my account for a week and now my entire taste profile is destroyed. Spotify thinks I'm into children's music and K-pop. There's no way to reset or edit your listening history. This is a critical missing feature.

reviews.author: PrivateSessions
reviews.title: Private session doesn't truly isolate listening
reviews.content: Even with private sessions turned on, certain songs I play seem to bleed into my recommendations. If private session is supposed to prevent algorithmic learning, it's not working as advertised.

reviews.author: AudiobookPush
reviews.title: Audiobooks I never asked for keep appearing
reviews.content: Audiobooks now take up an entire section of my home screen. I've never played an audiobook on Spotify. This is a purely commercial decision to push a new product at the expense of user experience.

reviews.author: LyricsFeature
reviews.title: Lyrics feature is great but misses songs
reviews.content: I love the lyrics feature but it's missing lyrics for so many songs, especially non-English music. Spotify should crowdsource lyrics corrections like Wikipedia for accuracy.

reviews.author: AppleMusicCompare
reviews.title: Apple Music algorithm is better now
reviews.content: I switched from Apple Music to Spotify a year ago for the social features. But now I'm reconsidering. Apple Music's algorithm has gotten significantly better at discovery while Spotify's feels stagnant. The grass might actually be greener.

reviews.author: MoodBasedPlaylist
reviews.title: Mood-based listening mode would be revolutionary
reviews.content: I wish Spotify had a mood-detection feature where it adjusts music based on your activity. Going for a run? Tempo increases. Winding down before sleep? BPM gradually decreases. The data is there, use it.

reviews.author: HappyListener
reviews.title: Spotify wrapped is genuinely the best marketing campaign
reviews.content: Say what you will about Spotify's product decisions, but Spotify Wrapped is genuinely brilliant marketing. The personalization makes it feel like a gift. I look forward to it every December.

reviews.author: DiscoveredNewArtist
reviews.title: Discover Weekly saved my music life
reviews.content: I know people complain about the algorithm but Discover Weekly genuinely introduced me to my new favorite artist last month who I'd never have found otherwise. When it works, it really works.

reviews.author: LongTermUser
reviews.title: Been using Spotify for 10 years and still love it
reviews.content: I've been a Spotify user since 2014. Despite the complaints I have, no other platform comes close to the overall combination of catalog size, UI polish, and social features. It's still the best option available.
